meta.notes: A potion tag gives one name to several potion ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. A brewing recipe's input can take every potion of a tag ("potion_contents": { "potions": "#msm_examples:swiftness_potions" }). Vanilla's #minecraft:tradeable lists the potions villagers sell as tipped arrows.
